<!-- Release: v0.20.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- More visible player perspective, smoothly varying artwork edges, cleaner double-triangle transport, and firmer gesture ownership.
- Continuous frosted menu transitions, shape-based bounce, magnetic navigation with haptics, three selector styles and adjustable adaptive contrast.
- Connected clear selection lenses, reversible linear pinch layouts, glass settings/sorting choices and a permission-aware artwork chooser.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/99 - Glass transitions, navigation feedback and material consistency.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/100 - Player carousel, controls and gestures.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/101 - Connected selections, reversible zoom and collection/editor polish.

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.20.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. It updates the existing development app.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
